title: Program & Kernel Compartmentalization
subtitle: Language-agnostic automatic program partitioning, intra-kernel isolation, and compile-time privilege separation.
description: We design low-cost, fine-grained compartmentalization and isolation mechanisms for both full operating systems and resource-constrained embedded kernels without prohibitive performance overhead.
highlights: Pieces: Programmable, language-agnostic automatic program compartmentalization framework
SeRTOS (EC & CRT): Security-Enhanced FreeRTOS with compile-time privilege separation and intra-kernel isolation

title: Embedded, Cyber-Physical & Robotics Security
subtitle: Hardware-assisted reference monitors, MMIO security for autonomous vehicles, and ICS attack detection.
description: Investigating vulnerabilities and building defenses for cyber-physical systems, unmanned aerial/ground vehicles, and industrial control systems (ICS).
highlights: M2MON: MMIO-based hardware reference monitor for unmanned vehicles (USENIX Security '21)
SAIN: State-aware invariants for ICS attack detection sensitivity (USENIX Security '24)
Real-time sensor/actuator validation against physical spoofing

tools.name: M2MON
tools.description: MMIO security monitor for unmanned aerial/ground vehicles.

title: Confidential Computing & Hardware Enclaves
subtitle: Zero-trust enclave architectures, privacy-preserving protocols, and automated enclave fuzzing.
description: Architecting secure execution mechanisms across hardware enclaves (Intel SGX, TEEs) and discovering subtle boundary interaction vulnerabilities.
highlights: FuzzSGX: Fuzzing SGX enclaves via host program mutations (EuroS&P '23)
Privacy-preserving localization protocols utilizing hardware enclaves (UEMCON '21)

tools.name: FuzzSGX
tools.description: Automated host-mutation fuzzer for Intel SGX enclaves.

title: Program Analysis, Decompilation & Edge AI Security
subtitle: Symbolic differentiation for decompiler verification and dynamic DNN reverse engineering on edge devices.
description: Developing principled program analysis techniques to test binary analysis tools and examine neural network architectures deployed on edge hardware.
highlights: D-Helix: Generic decompiler testing framework via symbolic differentiation (USENIX Security '24)
NeuroScope: Reverse engineering deep neural networks on edge devices (USENIX Security '25)
Automated semantic equivalence checking across decompiled binaries
